page_title: JPN 2-1 SPA | Japan v Spain 01/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Good play from Dani Olmo (Spain) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
90+5' Pedri (Spain) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:11.
90' The attendance is 44851.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Dani Olmo (Spain) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Shuichi Gonda is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.

90' Marco Asensio (Spain) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Shuichi Gonda!
89' Jordi Alba (Spain) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
87' Substitution. Wataru Endo (Japan) in, Ao Tanaka out.
86' 18:82 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
85' Marco Asensio (Spain) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Ko Itakura (Japan) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon keeps it out.
83' Ritsu Doan (Japan) takes a direct free kick.
83' Sergio Busquets (Spain) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes no option but to blow his whistle.
80' Dani Olmo (Spain) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
78' Jordi Alba (Spain) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
77' Some patient build-up play from Spain as they look to unlock the defence.
74' Daniel Carvajal (Spain) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
72' Ferran Torres (Spain) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
70' It's a weak and poor shot by Takuma Asano (Japan) as he flashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies well wide of the right post.
68' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Japan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daichi Kamada.

68' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ansu Fati (Spain) replacing Gavi.
67' Spain seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
65' Pedri (Spain) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle for a foul.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Takuma Asano (Japan) for Daizen Maeda.
57' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Alvaro Morata and he is replaced by Marco Asensio (Spain).
57' Substitution. Nico Williams did his best and is replaced by Ferran Torres (Spain).

51' Japan score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
51' Ao Tanaka (Japan) put the ball in the net but it’s not going to stand as the ball went out of play.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nico Williams (Spain) heads on.

46' Hajime Moriyasu has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kaoru Mitoma comes on the pitch for Yuto Nagatomo (Japan).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Cesar Azpilicueta (Spain) is replaced by Daniel Carvajal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Dani Olmo (Spain) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45+1' Nico Williams (Spain) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Maya Yoshida (Japan) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
44' Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes shows a yellow card to Shogo Taniguchi (Japan) for his blatant foul.
43' Dani Olmo (Spain) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
42' The ball possession at the moment is 18:82.
39' Ko Itakura (Japan) has tested the patience of referee Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Daichi Kamada (Japan) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
35' Daichi Kamada (Japan) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
33' Shogo Taniguchi (Japan) brings his opponent down. Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Daizen Maeda (Japan) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
29' Dani Olmo (Spain) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
28' Hidemasa Morita (Japan) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' Alejandro Balde (Spain) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
25' Alvaro Morata (Spain) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' Alvaro Morata (Spain) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Shuichi Gonda.
20' Gavi (Spain) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

18' Dani Olmo (Spain) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Miguel de Freitas Gomes with no other option than to blow for a foul.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 15:85.

10' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
9' Dani Olmo (Spain) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
9' Alejandro Balde (Spain) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
8' Good chance! Junya Ito (Japan) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
7' The ball rebounds out to Sergio Busquets (Spain) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
7' A pass into the penalty area from Nico Williams (Spain) is intercepted by the defence.
5' Takefusa Kubo (Japan) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
4' Great teamplay by Spain as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Gavi (Spain) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
